comment: The engine's allowed unsafe items (no-cliffs C-2c-ii scope r4 section 1.3): scripts/unsafe-inventory.mjs --check compares them with the tree. hash: sha256 of the item's tokens (its outer attributes included; comments and layout excluded). audit: the answer to the boundary question for that item; a new or changed item needs a fresh review and audit.

premises.external_proc_macros_audit: Trusted dependencies (scope r4: external crates and their macro expansions are the trusted boundary). The compiler sweep can't see their expansions (rustc treats them as external), so the exact name/version set is pinned: a new proc-macro dependency or a version change fails until reviewed.

engine/flint/build.rs.audit: Emits only cargo link directives (link-search, static/dylib libs); writes no Rust source and nothing is include!d. Test-only crate (never in a shipped graph).

engine/node/build.rs.audit: napi_build::setup() only: N-API link arguments; writes no Rust source, and engine/node has no include!.

premises.no_ledger_dep_audit: Checked per crate from its manifest (any dependency section, any name); with no re-export of sagebrush_ledger anywhere (also checked), a crate on this list cannot name a ledger type.
